answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus enforces Sybil resistance by tethering voting power to capital assets. Like a gale sweeping across a reef, the protocol punishes malicious nodes by slashing their staked yarrow or native tokens. To compromise the network, an attacker must acquire a majority share of the total supply, making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively expensive compared to the potential gains from a successful re-organization attack.
